entries.name: Fat Chip GB
entries.note: The Game Boy half of Fat Chip. Latest build pushed to the fat-chip-gb repo.

variants.label: 1.4.0-ts (tstirrat) · ch 1–5
variants.note: tstirrat's maintained fork: current GBDK, wrong-pitch and memory-access fixes. MIDI channels 1–5.

variants.label: Hydra (any channels)
variants.note: Fork of tstirrat's mGB: pick the MIDI channel for each Game Boy voice on screen (or by CC).

variants.label: 1.3.0 · ch 6–10
variants.note: nitro2k01's fixed-channel build of mGB 1.3.0: listens on MIDI channels 6–10 (from defensem3ch's v1.3.4-unofficial release).

variants.label: 1.3.0 · ch 11–15
variants.note: nitro2k01's fixed-channel build of mGB 1.3.0: listens on MIDI channels 11–15 (from defensem3ch's v1.3.4-unofficial release).

entries.name: LSDj
entries.note: Little Sound Dj. Best alone on a page with no menu.
entries.howTo: littlesounddj.com doesn't let other websites download LSDj, so get the .zip there and add it here once; this browser keeps it. Add a newer one the same way to update.

entries.name: Fat Chip 64
entries.note: The C64 half of Fat Chip. Latest build pushed to the fat-chip-64 repo. Flash with DATEL MIDI.

note: mGB builds are GPL-2.0 (see LICENSE-mGB.md); sources: github.com/trash80/mGB, tstirrat/mGB, AP-AAiS/mGB_Hydra, defensem3ch/mGB.
